title: SITORA Intent
description: Strategic intent: a versioned, attributable, scoped requirement representing what the organization intends, requires, permits, prohibits, prioritizes, or expects.

id.description: Stable identifier for this intent (e.g., obligation id).

version.description: Semantic version of this intent statement.

statement.description: Human-readable statement of the intent / obligation.

scope.description: Defined population and time period this intent applies to.

owner.description: Accountable owner of this intent (role or named entity).

authoritativeSource.description: System or document of record for this intent (e.g., policy id).
